title: @ai-sdk/google stopped working with function calling in production

linked_prs.title: fix (provider/google): prevent error when thinking signature is used
linked_prs.body:
## Background

The Google API for reasoning was changed in their latest model, leading to Zod errors.

## Summary

Make text optional in thinking chunks. Ignore thinking chunks without text.

## Verification

Tested example against google api.

## Future work
Expose thinking signature using provider metadata, and explore sending it to google in follow-up requests.

## Related Issues
Fixes #6589

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

The error arises from provider-specific response parsing and function calling, fitting the "Incompatibility with LLM providers" and "Incorrect model output handlers" agent issue categories.
